Q1: Chloroethane presents significant known hazards, including carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, or reproductive toxicity (CMR1), dermal/eye (SKN1), and organ/systemic (OGN1) hazards. Oral hazards are assessed as low to moderate (ORL3), while its endocrine disruption profile (EDC4) is currently data deficient.

This indicates recognized significant hazards across multiple regulatory frameworks.
Q3: This chemical is exceptionally well-characterized, boasting 10,000 literature references, placing it among the most studied chemicals in our database.
